title: The Five Commandments of the Scene
summary: Every scene is an atomic dramatic quantum requiring 5 events: Inciting Incident, Progressive Complication turning point, Crisis question, Climax action, and Resolution.

title: Dwight Swain's Motivating-Reaction Units (MRUs)
summary: Prose rhythm sequencing: Cause outside the POV character (Motivation) precedes Effect inside the character (Feeling -> Reflex -> Rational Action).

title: Emotional Value Shifts & Polarity
summary: A scene that does not turn on an emotional value polarity (e.g. Hope to Despair, Ignorance to Revelation) is a non-event.

title: AI-Tell Detection & Cadence Preservation
summary: Detects corporate voice flattening, cliché throat-clearing, and symmetry traps. Preserves idiosyncratic human author voice.
